interpretation: Five PCA patch components per channel retain about 99% of wave+Gray patch variance but fail to preserve dynamically essential low-variance directions needed for robust transfer to unseen NLS/advection. The full raw 3x3 stencil control remains near-exact on those unseen families, so the regression architecture/locality is viable; unsupervised variance compression is the failure.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law systems only; no unrestricted operator discovery or novel physics claim.
